title: You're Not Alone
description: Ever get sad, or anxious? So do I. So does everyone. But you don't have to be alone in those horrible moments. In this file... you aren't alone. I'm there with you, laying in bed next to you, holding you tight while I whisper calmly in your ear. Talking you through a panic attack, talking you through a depressive moment when your demons have taken hold and all you want is to be told it's going to be OK. It's temporary and you will get through it. And it will be OK. Because I'm here, I'm with you, and I am going to help you through it. Part dominant girlfriend, part hypnosis, part scene, all gentle and loving as I coax you through a really shitty time until you can lay your head on my breast and just relax. No HFO or JOI, this file isn't about erotica, there will be some undertones of D/s, but mostly will be about calming your breathing, telling you about my day as I hold and comfort you, and then slowly easing you into trance without ever mentioning the word. It's about feeling connected and intimate and knowing my voice is always there for you.
author: Mistress Shibby
